title: Final: full E2E suite, residual triage, all gates, mark remake jobs resolved
goal: Prove the whole system: full desktop e2e green (incl. travellers.spec.ts), backend and driver tests green, FR register checks pass, remake pipeline shows all jobs ok.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Baseline: 560 passed / 179 failed / 10 skipped / 46 did not run of 795 (56 min). After B09 the auth cascade is gone; the remaining failures should be few. FR detection checks are in desktop/showcase/STORYBOARD.md section 0.4.
steps: Reset slot 0 DB (`fix-stack up --slot 0 --reset-db`), run `npx playwright test` (full, excluding showcase/), collect failures.

Classify each failure: spec staleness -> fix the spec; small app bug (<= ~10 files total across all fixes) -> fix; anything larger -> stop and report to the planner with evidence (do not start a refactor).
Re-run backend vitest, desktop tsc/vitest/lint/build, flutter analyze/test and the driver smoke integration test (B13 recipe).

Run every FR detection check from STORYBOARD 0.4 (FR-1 curl, FR-2 smoke test, FR-2b grep, FR-3 sidebar, FR-4 pubspec, FR-5 template body, FR-6 picker, FR-7 trip type + Book transfer, FR-8 timeline label, FR-9 notification click, FR-10 New template, FR-11 30-min idle: emulate by expiring the access token as in token-refresh.spec) and record pass/fail in desktop/audit/fix/gates/FINAL.json.

Mark remake jobs resolved: `node scripts/remake-pipeline.js --mark-ok verify:travellers --note "fixed in fix pass"` and likewise cleanup and showcase (showcase note: re-recorded by the showcase agent).

From the B17 triage: flaky under the full run - fleet-trips.spec.ts:494 and test-harness.spec.ts:23 (seed fetch failed: SocketError other side closed from wrangler dev), communication-inbox.spec.ts:45/:80/:92 (seen once). Make e2e/helpers/api-seed.ts retry idempotent seed calls on transport errors (not on HTTP errors), and root-cause the communication-inbox flake. Target: 3 consecutive full-suite runs with 0 failures.
acceptance: Full e2e: 0 failed (skips must each have a reason).
FINAL.json lists every FR as pass.
notes: This is the final gate before the showcase executor records.
